ya10.3.6:2.1: Yo v. p. domanassind. pajahissati, so cakkhund. parijānitthāti? No.
ya10.3.6:5.1: [parijānittha-bhāvissati] and for cakkhund.-aññind. [do do], and for cakkhund.- aññātāvind. [parijānittha--sacchikarissati].)
ya10.3.6:10.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvissati . . . No.
ya10.3.6:11.1: Yo domanassind. pajahittha, so aññind. bhāvissatīti?
ya10.3.6:12.1: Dve puggalā domanassind. pajahittha, no ca aññind. bhāvissatīti; anāgāmī domanassind. ca . . .
ya10.3.6:13.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvissanti . . . Pañca
ya10.3.6:14.1: puggalā aññind. bhāvissanti, no ca domanassind. pajahittha; anāgāmī aññindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:15.1: Yo domanassind. pajahittha, so aññātāvind. sacchikarissatīti?
ya10.3.6:18.1: Cha puggalā aññātāvind. sacchikarissanti, no ca domanassind. pajahittha; dve puggalā aññātāvindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:21.1: Yo v. p. aññind. bhāvissati . . . Aṭṭhamako
ya10.3.6:22.1: aññind. bhāvissati, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha; pañca puggalā aññindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:23.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha, so aññātāvind. sacchikarissatīti?
ya10.3.6:25.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarissati, so anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.6:26.1: Dve puggalā aññātāvind. sacchikarissanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. bhāvittha; cha puggalā aññindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:27.1: Yo aññind. bhāvittha, so aññātāvind. sacchikarissatīti? Āmantā.
ya10.3.6:28.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarissati, so aññind. bhāvitthāti? No. 12.
ya10.3.6:29.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānittha, so domanassind. nappa jahissatīti?
ya10.3.6:30.1: Pañca puggalā cakkhund. na parijānittha, no ca domanassind. nappajahissanti; tayo puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca na parijānittha, domanassindriyañ ca nappajahissanti.
ya10.3.6:31.1: Yo vā pana domanassind. nappajahissati, so cakkhund. na parijānitthāti?
ya10.3.6:32.1: Arahā domanassind. nappajahissati, no ca cakkhund. na parijānittha; tayo puggalā domanassindriyañ ca nappajahissanti, cakkhundriyañ ca na parijānittha.
ya10.3.6:33.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānittha, so anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvissatīti?
ya10.3.6:34.1: Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, te cakkhund. na parijānittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvissanti; aṭṭha puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:35.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvissati . . .
ya10.3.6:36.1: Arahā anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvissati, no ca cakkhund. na parijānittha; aṭṭha puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:37.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānittha, so aññind. na bhāvissatīti?
ya10.3.6:38.1: Satta puggalā cakkhund. na parijānittha, no ca aññind. na bhāvissanti; dve puggalā cakkhundriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:39.1: Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvissati . . .
ya10.3.6:40.1: Arahā aññind. na bhāvissati, no ca cakkhund. na parijānittha; dve puggalā aññindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:41.1: Yo cakkhund. na parijānittha, so aññātāvind. na sacchikarissatīti?
ya10.3.6:42.1: Chā puggalā cakkhund. na parijānittha, no ca aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarissanti; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te cakkhundriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:43.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarissati, so cakkhund. na parijānitthāti?
ya10.3.6:44.1: Arahā aññātāvind. na sacchikarissati, no ca cakkhund. na parijānittha; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarissanti, cakkhundriyañ ca na parijānittha.
ya10.3.6:45.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahittha, so anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvissatīti?
ya10.3.6:46.1: Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti, te domanassind. nappajahittha, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvissanti; cha puggalā domanassindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:47.1: Yo v. p. anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvissati . . . Dve
ya10.3.6:48.1: puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvissanti, no ca domanassind. nappajahittha; cha puggalā anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca na bhāvissanti, domanassindriyañ ca nappajahittha.
ya10.3.6:49.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahittha, so aññind. na bhāvissatīti?
ya10.3.6:50.1: Cha puggalā domanassind. nappajahittha, no ca aññind. na bhāvissanti; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te domanassindriyañ ca nappajahittha, aññindriyañ ca na bhāvissanti.
ya10.3.6:51.1: Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvissati . . .
ya10.3.6:52.1: Dve puggalā aññind. na bhāvissanti, no ca domanassind. nappajahittha; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te aññindriyañ ca na bhāvissanti; domanassindriyañ ca nappajahittha.
ya10.3.6:53.1: Yo domanassind. nappajahittha, so aññātāvind. na sacchikarissatīti?
ya10.3.6:54.1: Pañca puggalā domanassind. nappajahittha, no ca aññātāvind. na sacchikarissanti; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te domanassindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:55.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarissati . . .
ya10.3.6:56.1: Arahā aññātāvind. na sacchikarissati, no ca domanassind. nappajahittha; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarissanti, domanassindriyañ ca nappajahittha.
ya10.3.6:57.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha, so aññind. na bhāvissatīti?
ya10.3.6:58.1: Dve puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha, no ca aññind. na bhāvissanti; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca na bhāvittha, aññindriyañ ca na bhāvissanti.
ya10.3.6:59.1: Yo v. p. aññind. na bhāvissati, so anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.6:60.1: Dve puggalā aññind. na bhāvissanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te aññindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:61.1: Yo anaññātaññassāmītind. no bhāvittha, so aññātāvind. na sacchikarissatīti?
ya10.3.6:62.1: Dve puggalā anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha, no ca aññātāvind. na sacchikarissanti; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te anaññātaññassāmītindriyañ ca na bhāvittha, aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarissanti.
ya10.3.6:63.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarissati . . .
ya10.3.6:64.1: Arahā aññātāvind. na sacchikarissati, no ca anaññātaññassāmītind. na bhāvittha; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te aññātāvindriyañ ca . . .
ya10.3.6:65.1: Yo aññind. na bhāvittha so aññātāvind. na sacchikarissatīti?
ya10.3.6:66.1: Aṭṭha puggalā aññind. na bhāvittha, no ca aññātāvind. na sacchikarissanti; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te aññindriyañ ca na bhāvittha aññindriyañ ca na sacchikarissanti.
ya10.3.6:67.1: Yo v. p. aññātāvind. na sacchikarissati, so aññind. na bhāvitthāti?
ya10.3.6:68.1: Arahā aññātāvind. na sacchikarissati, no ca aññind. na bhāvittha; ye puthujjanā maggaṃ na paṭilabhissanti, te aññātāvindriyañ ca na sacchikarissanti, aññindriyañ ca na bhāvitthāti. INDRIYAYAMAKAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ. YAMAKAPPAKARAṆAṂ
